content: HITL AI review UI pattern: three core actions (approve/reject/edit, sometimes escalate); AI suggests, human decides, nothing auto-executes until approved; approval UI should show a diff/before-after so reviewer never has to guess what will happen; every decision logged with timestamp/reviewer/reason; route low-confidence and high-risk items to human attention, but confidence score alone is an unreliable routing signal so it's usually combined with business rules (e.g. a controlled-vocabulary validator).
